name: MC30W
tagline: Slim N100 network appliance with four 2.5GbE ports
description: MC30W combines Intel N100 processing, up to 16GB DDR5 and four Intel i226 2.5GbE ports in a 136 x 126 x 40 mm enclosure. NVMe, SATA and module slots support configurable storage and connectivity.

specs.label: Graphics
specs.value: Integrated Intel graphics; exact GPU depends on the selected CPU

specs.label: Display
specs.value: 1 x DP port; 1 x HDMI port

specs.label: Serial ports USB
specs.value: 1 x RJ45 COM 2 x USB3.0; 4 x USB2.0 (Built-in pin)

specs.label: Expansion
specs.value: 1 x Mini pCle Channel for WiFi/Bluetooth/4G; 1 x M.2 2242 (Support 5G Communication)

specs.label: Front I/O
specs.value: 1 x Power Adapter port; 4 x 2.5G Ethernet port; 1 x RJ45 COM

specs.label: Rear I/O
specs.value: 2 x USB3.0; 4 x USB2.0; 1 x HDMI (With audio output); 1 x DP; 1 x Power Button; 1 x Power HDD LED; 1 x CLR-CMOS; 1 x 4G SIM Card slot; 1 x 5G SiM Card slot

specs.label: Internal I/O
specs.value: 1 x SATA Interface; 1 x M.2 Interface; 1 x Mini PCIE Channel for WiFi/Bluetooth/4G; 1 x F-PANEL pin

specs.label: Storage
specs.value: 1 x M.2 NVMe 2280; 1 x SATA3.0 (supports 2.5-inch HDD/SSD)
